SAWAN: CEO; 266,533 ordinary shares at January 1, 2025 and 378,519 at December 31, 2025. BLACKROCK: 457,454,997 shares from a Schedule 13G/A filed April 23, 2025 (the 20-F gives no as-of date, so asOf is the filing date), divided by the ordinary shares outstanding at March 4, 2026; the 20-F lists only investors with 5% or more. DIVIDENDS exclude $147m paid to non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS exclude $1,300m of 'Shares held in trust: net purchases and dividends received' (employee share plan trusts). STOCK COMP is the equity-settled share-based compensation expense in Note 28 ($774m, also in the employee costs note). After the fiscal year, Shell acquired ARC Resources Ltd. in the third quarter of 2026, partly for newly issued shares (228,003,843 shares issued in 2026, per the Q3 2026 interim report).

footprint.notes: Countries come from the country-by-country reporting (CbCR) table 'Our tax data by jurisdiction' in Shell's Tax Contribution Report 2024 (94 jurisdictions; India and Saudi Arabia sit at page breaks). No newer edition found (checked Nov 24, 2026): Shell's Tax Contribution Report page still lists the 2024 report as the latest; it re-issued the 2024 report on Aug 20, 2026 with a restated 'Total tax contribution' table (employer, indirect and employee taxes), which does not change the CbCR tax-paid or employee columns used here. Tax paid is corporate income tax paid (cash-flow basis) in whole dollars in the source, converted to USD millions without rounding; '–' entries (Bermuda, Cayman Islands) are omitted. Employees are 2024 average FTEs eligible for Shell's standard terms, so they do not match the 20-F year-end headcount (85,000 at Dec 31, 2025, incl. portfolio companies). The 2025 20-F also gives employees by region (Africa 2, Asia 33, Europe 26, North America 21, Oceania 3, South America 2, in thousands, year-end 2025) but rounded to thousands, so not repeated. Royalties and other payments to governments (Report on Payments to Governments) are not included. Shell publishes no U.S. state breakdown of these measures. Sites are re-sourced from the 2025 20-F: the Queensland site is now named as Shell's QCLNG operations (the 20-F no longer uses 'Shell QGC'), the Rotterdam biofuels plant will not be completed, and Monaca is placed in Pennsylvania as the 2025 20-F states.
